The print room

Got a design?
We’ll print it.

DTF (direct-to-film) printing means photo-quality colour, fine detail and a soft, durable finish on almost any fabric — no cracking, no peeling, no fading wash after wash. Upload a logo, a photo or your own artwork and see it on the garment before you pay.

Upload your artwork

PNG, JPG, PDF or vector files. We check every file by hand and flag anything that won’t print sharply.

See it before we print

Preview your design on the garment in our customiser, then get a free digital proof for final approval.

One or one thousand

A single gift tee or a full team kit — tiered pricing means bulk orders automatically cost less per item.

About us

A small studio with
big print energy.

Emily’s Printing is an independent UK print studio built around one simple idea: custom printing should look brilliant and feel easy. We print clothing for birthdays, brands, bands, businesses and five-a-side teams — and large-format banners that help local shops and events stand out.

Everything is printed to order, checked by hand and packed by people who care about the details — because your name, your logo or your kid’s drawing is on it.

Good to know

Frequently asked questions

PNG with a transparent background is ideal for clothing (300dpi at print size if you can), and we also accept JPG, PDF, AI, EPS and SVG. For banners, PDF or high-resolution JPG works best. If your file is low resolution we’ll tell you honestly before printing — and we can often help tidy artwork up.

Adult clothing runs from XS to 3XL on most styles (some up to 5XL — ask us). Kids’ clothing covers ages 3–4 up to 11–12 years. Every product page lists the exact sizes available, and we’re happy to mix sizes within a bulk order at no extra fuss.

We print large-format up to A0 (841 × 1189mm) as standard, and PVC banners in custom sizes well beyond that — just tell us the width and height you need. Banners come hemmed with metal eyelets unless you ask otherwise, and roller banners are supplied ready to display.

Yes — pricing is tiered, so the per-item cost drops automatically at 10, 25 and 50+ items in the customiser. For regular trade orders, school kits or 100+ runs, request a quote and we’ll work out the best rate for the full job.

Most clothing orders are printed and dispatched within 3–5 working days of proof approval. Banners typically take 2–4 working days. Working to a deadline — an event, a launch, a match day? Tell us the date in your quote request and we’ll confirm what’s possible before you commit.

UK delivery is £3.99 on orders under £60 and free over £60. Every parcel is sent tracked, and large banners are rolled and tubed so they arrive crease-free. Local collection from the studio can be arranged — just ask.
